decisions.decision: Set RUSTFLAGS=-D warnings in features.yml workflow
decisions.rationale: The workflow catches the same cfg mismatch defects as verify.yml, but had been letting identical defects through as warnings nobody reads.
decisions.quote: verify.yml set it and features.yml did not, while the two exist to catch the same defect: a #[cfg] that does not match what the code needs.

decisions.decision: Fix the six items with cfg attributes rather than warning suppressions
decisions.rationale: The author chose attributes over suppressions for the six items.
decisions.quote: Every fix is an attribute, not a suppression.

decisions.decision: Gate RatInterval import behind feature cosmo
decisions.rationale: RatInterval is only parse_redshift's return type and nothing else's, so it arrives with cosmo or not at all.
decisions.quote: RatInterval is parse_redshift's return type and nothing else's, so cosmo.

decisions.decision: Gate qualified::Kind import behind feature civil
decisions.rationale: It is read once, by to-civil.
decisions.quote: qualified::Kind is read once by to-civil, so civil.

decisions.decision: Gate Rounding import behind feature civil
decisions.rationale: Rounding is to-civil's default when --round is absent.
decisions.quote: Rounding is to-civil's default when --round is absent.

decisions.decision: Gate parse_form and codec::Form behind all(civil, std)
decisions.rationale: They belong to run_now, which needs both civil and std features.
decisions.quote: parse_form and codec::Form belong to run_now, which needs civil and std.

decisions.rationale: It is called by events for a window's width and by cosmo for an enclosure's ends; no single feature name could express that shape.
decisions.quote: years_quantity is called by events for a window's width and by cosmo for an enclosure's ends, so any(events, cosmo) — a shape no single feature name could express, which is why it had no attribute rather than a wrong one.

decisions.decision: Do not exclude the refused job from -D warnings
decisions.rationale: The refused job defends the property that the backend guard is the first error line; the flag could break that but checks still hold.
decisions.quote: The refused job inherits the flag and its checks still hold — the backend guard is still the first error line, which is the property that job defends and the one -D warnings could most easily have broken.

decisions.decision: Split sign-release error message into two messages based on gh auth status
decisions.rationale: The original message conflated two conditions with different remedies; the first person to hit it was unauthenticated, not missing a release.
decisions.quote: Two conditions with different remedies now get two messages, which is the shape D-A24 catalogued.

prerequisites.text: The five libraries compile without warnings, so -D warnings will not break them.
prerequisites.quote: The five libraries were already clean

prerequisites.text: parse_redshift is compiled only when feature cosmo is enabled.
prerequisites.quote: RatInterval is parse_redshift's return type and nothing else's, so cosmo.

prerequisites.text: to-civil is compiled only when feature civil is enabled; qualified::Kind is only needed there.
prerequisites.quote: qualified::Kind is read once by to-civil, so civil.

prerequisites.text: to-civil is compiled only when feature civil is enabled; Rounding is needed only as to-civil's default.
prerequisites.quote: Rounding is to-civil's default when --round is absent.

prerequisites.text: run_now is compiled only when both civil and std features are enabled.
prerequisites.quote: parse_form and codec::Form belong to run_now, which needs civil and std.

prerequisites.text: years_quantity is called by events for a window's width and by cosmo for an enclosure's ends, and by no other features.
prerequisites.quote: years_quantity is called by events for a window's width and by cosmo for an enclosure's ends, so any(events, cosmo) — a shape no single feature name could express

prerequisites.text: The backend guard remains the first error line under -D warnings.
prerequisites.quote: the backend guard is still the first error line

prerequisites.text: `gh auth status` command exits successfully only when authenticated.
The two failure conditions (no release and gh unauthenticated) have different remedies.
prerequisites.quote: Two conditions with different remedies now get two messages

alternatives.alternative: Set -D warnings only in verify.yml, leaving features.yml without it.
alternatives.reason: The two workflows exist to catch the same defect, so warnings in features.yml were never read.
alternatives.quote: verify.yml set it and features.yml did not

alternatives.alternative: Use warning suppressions rather than cfg attributes for the six items.
alternatives.reason: Every fix is an attribute, not a suppression.
alternatives.quote: Every fix is an attribute, not a suppression.

alternatives.alternative: Leave the RatInterval import unconditional, accepting unused-import warnings in eight builds.
alternatives.reason: An import unused in eight combinations is a missing cfg attribute.
alternatives.quote: An import that is unused in eight of the twenty-three feature combinations is a `#[cfg]` that was never written

alternatives.alternative: Leave the qualified::Kind import without a cfg gate.
alternatives.reason: It is read once by to-civil, so it should exist only with civil.
alternatives.quote: qualified::Kind is read once by to-civil, so civil.

alternatives.alternative: Leave the Rounding import without a cfg gate.
alternatives.reason: Rounding is to-civil's default when --round is absent, so it belongs to civil only.
alternatives.quote: Rounding is to-civil's default when --round is absent.

alternatives.alternative: Gate parse_form and codec::Form behind a single feature or leave them ungated.
alternatives.reason: They belong to run_now, which needs both civil and std, so all(civil, std) is required.
alternatives.quote: parse_form and codec::Form belong to run_now, which needs civil and std.

alternatives.alternative: Use a single feature name for years_quantity, such as events or cosmo.
alternatives.reason: No single feature name could express that it is called by both events and cosmo.
alternatives.quote: a shape no single feature name could express, which is why it had no attribute rather than a wrong one.

alternatives.alternative: Exclude the refused job from -D warnings to protect the first-error-line property.
alternatives.reason: The refused job inherits the flag and checks still hold, so exclusion was unnecessary.
alternatives.quote: the backend guard is still the first error line, which is the property that job defends and the one -D warnings could most easily have broken

alternatives.alternative: Keep a single sign-release error message covering both conditions.
alternatives.reason: One diagnostic covering conditions with different remedies left the reader to guess which.
alternatives.quote: This said *no release, or `gh` cannot see it* and left the reader to guess which

consequences.text: Feature workflow now applies -D warnings to twenty-three combinations, catching cfg mismatch defects.
Six items fixed with cfg attributes, not warning suppressions.
consequences.quote: Every fix is an attribute, not a suppression.

consequences.text: RatInterval import is gated to cosmo because only parse_redshift uses it.
consequences.quote: RatInterval is parse_redshift's return type and nothing else's, so cosmo.

consequences.text: qualified::Kind import is gated to civil because to-civil reads it.
consequences.quote: qualified::Kind is read once by to-civil, so civil.

consequences.text: Rounding import is gated to civil because to-civil uses it when --round absent.
consequences.quote: Rounding is to-civil's default when --round is absent.

consequences.text: parse_form and codec::Form gated behind all(civil, std) because run_now needs both.
consequences.quote: parse_form and codec::Form belong to run_now, which needs civil and std.

consequences.text: years_quantity gated behind any(events, cosmo) because both features call it.
consequences.quote: years_quantity is called by events for a window's width and by cosmo for an enclosure's ends, so any(events, cosmo)

consequences.text: Refused job inherits -D warnings and its checks still hold with backend guard first.
consequences.quote: The refused job inherits the flag and its checks still hold
consequences.verification_quote: the backend guard is still the first error line

consequences.text: Sign-release splits error into separate messages for unauthenticated versus missing release conditions.
consequences.quote: Two conditions with different remedies now get two messages
